channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists link shared exercise to stronger marriages
item.description: Couples who exercise together report better communication, healthier conflict resolution, and lower marital stress than those who work out alone.

item.title: Physicists observe quarks forming waves in primordial plasma
item.description: Physicists at CERN's Large Hadron Collider have captured the clearest evidence yet that quark-gluon plasma, the hot matter of the early universe, behaves as a wave.

item.title: Archaeologists may have solved a century-old Florida mystery
item.description: Ancient pottery found in Tampa Bay appears to have been crafted by migrant artisans who brought specialized Mississippian pottery-making knowledge.

item.title: Scientists observe how nature transfers energy so efficiently
item.description: Researchers captured key steps in a chemical reaction that enables nature to transfer energy with remarkable efficiency, using ultrafast X-rays.
